title: 2026 waste voluntary MRV factor-governance QA controls

sources.title: Voluntary MRV period for EfW and waste incineration

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: UK ETS technical guidance: Monitoring and Reporting Regulation 2018

facts.source_fact: A voluntary MRV-only period operates before full UK ETS expansion to energy-from-waste and waste-incineration facilities.
facts.expected_handling: Keep voluntary-preparation data separate from mandatory UK ETS compliance data.

facts.source_fact: The voluntary MRV-only period started on 1 January 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Do not backdate voluntary-period records before the start date.

facts.source_fact: The Authority announced an intention for the MRV-only period to run from 2026 to 2028, subject to later policy confirmation.
facts.expected_handling: Treat the end point as policy intent until confirmed.

facts.source_fact: Participation is voluntary and there is no legal requirement to participate in the initial MRV-only period.
facts.expected_handling: Do not mark non-participation as regulatory non-compliance.

facts.source_fact: The guidance states there is no regulator fee for participation in the voluntary MRV-only period.
facts.expected_handling: Keep voluntary-period fee status separate from future mandatory charges.

facts.source_fact: There is no penalty for non-participation in the voluntary MRV-only period.
facts.expected_handling: Do not create penalty flags for non-participants.

facts.source_fact: The voluntary period is intended to help operators understand their emissions ahead of future scheme inclusion.
facts.expected_handling: Treat voluntary data as preparatory MRV evidence.

facts.source_fact: The voluntary period is intended to help operators understand future UK ETS cost exposure.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat estimated cost exposure as current liability.

facts.source_fact: Reported voluntary emissions help the UK ETS Authority build oversight of waste-sector emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve reporting-purpose context.

facts.source_fact: Voluntary reporting supports development of more robust, accurate and granular emissions factors.
facts.expected_handling: Version factor provenance and distinguish preliminary from mature factors.

facts.source_fact: Participating operators need a voluntary monitoring plan that acts as a manual for MRV tasks.
facts.expected_handling: Require monitoring-plan provenance for voluntary emissions data.

facts.source_fact: Operators monitor in line with the voluntary plan and submit emissions through an annual emissions report.
facts.expected_handling: Track report year and submission status.

facts.source_fact: Operators are encouraged to have voluntary annual emissions reports verified.
facts.expected_handling: Do not label unverified voluntary reports as independently verified.

facts.source_fact: Non-hazardous waste incineration is in scope where capacity exceeds 3 tonnes per hour.
facts.expected_handling: Apply capacity threshold before scope assignment.

facts.source_fact: Hazardous waste incineration is in scope where capacity exceeds 10 tonnes per day.
facts.expected_handling: Apply hazardous-waste threshold with correct units.

facts.source_fact: Clinical waste is included within the described voluntary-MRV scope.
facts.expected_handling: Do not exclude clinical waste solely by category.

facts.source_fact: Specified high-temperature hazardous-waste installations can be outside scope when the published temperature and waste-mix conditions are met.
facts.expected_handling: Require all exclusion conditions before excluding an installation.

facts.source_fact: Operators participate by contacting the relevant regulator and following regulator guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Bind participation evidence to jurisdiction and regulator.

facts.source_fact: VMRVP01 provides the technical guidance for waste activities during the voluntary MRV-only period.
facts.expected_handling: Carry technical-guidance version with monitoring methodology.

facts.source_fact: On 5 May 2026 VMRVP01 was revised to include preliminary and biomass-fraction emission factors in its annex.
facts.expected_handling: Label these factors with the May 2026 technical-guidance vintage and preliminary/biomass context.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve voluntary-period scope and factor wording.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents treating voluntary rules as mandatory.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach facility type, capacity, waste type and participation status.
Attach voluntary-period and factor-guidance version dates.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents use of stale or superseded factors.

guard_patterns.handling: Carry monitoring plan, annual report, verification and VMRVP01 provenance.
Do not convert installation voluntary-MRV data into parcel-level measured emissions.
